description: This file defines the MqttPingHandler class, which manages MQTT ping requests and responses, handles idle events to maintain connection health, and schedules disconnects if no ping response is received within the keepalive interval.

classes.name: MqttPingHandler
classes.description: A Netty handler that manages MQTT ping requests/responses, detects idle connections, and schedules disconnects if no response is received.

methods.name: channelRead
methods.description: Processes incoming MQTT messages, handling PINGREQ and PINGRESP types.

methods.name: userEventTriggered
methods.description: Handles idle state events to trigger ping requests.

methods.name: sendPingReq
methods.description: Sends a PINGREQ message and schedules disconnect if no PINGRESP is received.

methods.name: handlePingReq
methods.description: Responds to a PINGREQ with a PINGRESP.

methods.name: handlePingResp
methods.description: Cancels scheduled disconnect upon receiving a PINGRESP.
